title: Jars and Jars and Jars
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A mother came, so sad and poor,
one pot of oil, no more.
Elisha said, “Go borrow jars
from neighbors right next door.”

[Chorus]
When you obey, the Lord provides;
He knows just what to do.
Your little bit becomes a lot,
for He takes care of you.

[Verse 2]
She shut the door and poured and poured;
the oil just wouldn’t stop
until the very last big jar
was filled up to the top.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; the jars are full,
the last one’s on the shelf.
Heavenly Father knows your home
and cares for it Himself.

[Chorus]
mood: Pouring music. A slow, flowing pulse under the voice, smooth and continuous like oil running from one jar into the next, never jerky. Each chorus keeps the flow going a little fuller, the way the miracle keeps coming. By the last verse it slows and settles low, the last jar filled, the door shut, the room at rest.
